text: There is ambiguity about the scoring method for the evaluation, including whether to sum the scores and divide by four. Compatibility issues with WordPerfect and reliance on old disks may hamper access to documents. We decided on batteries as the power source for the remote and that a regular chip would be necessary for the more advanced iPod-like button. We will develop a variety of trendy fruit designs for the remote control and have opted to change the shape, motivated by playful testing with play-dough.
